tasks.description: Builds an audit pack index linking controls to their test notes and mapped evidence exports. Use when asked for an audit pack index of controls and evidence.
tasks.intent: Index controls with their test results and mapped evidence files.

tasks.description: Tabulates control test notes into a results table with exception rates and consistency checks. Use when asked for a control test results table from test notes.
tasks.intent: Tabulate control test results and flag results inconsistent with exception counts.

tasks.description: Derives an exceptions log from evidence exports and joins it with the exceptions register. Use when asked for an audit exceptions log built from evidence exports.
tasks.intent: Build an exceptions log from exports linked to register entries.
